summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a site tour for Utah legislators at its Velvet-Wood uranium-vanadium project. The filing describes policy milestones and project updates but does not involve any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. The press release is promotional in nature, highlighting regulatory support and project progress. No financial terms, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics are mentioned. As a routine report of a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K containing no special-situation trigger, this filing does not constitute a special situation. The role is filer.
